page.overview:
Who is Masaki Ando?

Masaki is a plain man with short dark brown hair.

Masaki is mindful of the law even in intense situations as he requested permission to use his gun before defending himself.

When Reze attacks the Anti-Devil 2nd Division's Training Facility in order to get Denji, Masaki Ando requests permission to shoot from a higher-up, before he is swiftly killed by her in an explosion.
